$comment: Expectations drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the pack was scored. The truth helper links @sentry/react outside the consumer, so React's types do not resolve from it and Sentry.ErrorBoundary reports TS2607/TS2786 in both repositories; a real scripts-off install of the target (youth-activity-scheduler, recorded in ../sentry/RESEARCH.md) leaves only the two sendDefaultPii errors, and neither upgrade touched ErrorBoundary. Those diagnostics are helper artifacts, not expectations.

repos.why: Vite/React frontend whose Sentry.init spreads a config and passes sendDefaultPii: false (TS2353), with a unit test asserting the option (TS2339). Upgrade 43afc60ff5d954791107af93ac33d7ce3f465ff9.

findings.note: TS2353; replaced by dataCollection { userInfo: false, cookies: false, httpHeaders: false, urlQueryParams: false }.
TS2339 options.sendDefaultPii; the assertion moves to dataCollection.

repos.why: Next.js Pages app that declares @sentry/react directly (ErrorBoundary, init in _app). Upgrade b21e87edaa1aca1323b20e516cca384429718a8d changes only package.json and the lockfile: nothing to migrate, every reported site would be a false positive. TypeScript 7.0.2 in the repository; compiled with this checkout's 5.9.3.
